snippet.title: Dan Lazer (Sachen) - Game Boy - Let's show
snippet.description: Mmm actually I kinda like this shooter. Yeah there is just one main music track (but I like it) and the enemies are all the same throughout the stages I played. But really not that bad. I'm sure you Game Boy addicts didn't know about this one...Try it out
